reviews.review:
GAME APPEARS ABANDONED

The game was running good, got first prestige and was enjoying the game and then problems started up again, ID cards were back on the bank tellers desk and credit cards couldn't be processed, the game is a buggy mess and it appears the developers have called it a day, they left without saying a word.

This is getting really frustrating, we get encouraged to help developers and they keep disappearing on us leaving behind games that are incomplete and results like this hurt the developers who do make games properly as nobody will trust them after being burnt so many times.
reviews.developer_response:
Hi, thanks a lot for the feedback.

I wanted to let you know that the save/load issue you mentioned has now been fixed  the game loads at the exact time it was saved, and research resumes automatically. I’m continuing to improve things based on player reports.

If you ever feel like giving the current version another try, I’d love to hear your thoughts.

Thanks again!

You're best supporter this game <3
